def transform(grid):
    # A solid horizontal separator divides two aligned masks. Mark their overlap.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if row[0] != 0 and all(value == row[0] for value in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(upper, lower)]
            for upper, lower in zip(top, bottom)]
